curation.script:
import copy
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd()
out=root/'build/native-watch-local-20261002'
r=json.loads((out/'report.json').read_text())
assert r['complete'] and r['passed'] and len(r['samples'])==192 and all(s['verified'] for s in r['samples'])
p=copy.deepcopy(r)
p['schema']='talven.native-watch-evidence.v1'
p['raw_report_sha256']=hashlib.sha256((out/'report.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
p.pop('git_status')
p['commands']=[{k:v for k,v in c.items() if k not in ('argv','stdout','stderr')} | {stream:{k:v for k,v in c[stream].items() if k!='path'} for stream in ('stdout','stderr')} for c in r['commands']]
for w in p['workloads']:
 for rev in w['revisions']:
  directory=out/'workloads'/w['id']/rev['id']
  rev['source_text']=(directory/'source.tal').read_text()
  if (directory/'oracle.c').exists():rev['oracle_text']=(directory/'oracle.c').read_text()
for s in p['sessions']:
 directory=out/s.pop('path')
 s.pop('argv')
 s['events']=[json.loads(line) for line in (directory/'events.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
 for event in s['events']:
  if event.get('event')=='session_started':
   event.pop('source',None)
   event['cc']='recorded trusted C driver'
 s['stdout_text']=(directory/'stdout').read_text()
p['curation']={'description':'Remove private command/source paths and Git working-tree status; preserve all samples, normalized session events, outputs and input/log identities; include exact source/oracle texts. Raw local report retained separately.', 'script':Path(__file__).read_text()}
destination=root/'experiments/results/native-watch-macos-arm64-20261002.json'
destination.write_text(json.dumps(p,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+'\n')
print('artifact',destination.name,'bytes',destination.stat().st_size,'sha256',hashlib.sha256(destination.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
print('compiler',r['compiler_hash'],'git',r['git_revision'],'wall',r['started_at'],r['finished_at'])
print('host',r['cpu_model'],r['python'],r['c_version'].splitlines()[0],r['c_target'],r['clock'])
